newsitem.title: USA: Marathon, Murphy find oil west of Brae Field.
newsitem.headline: Marathon, Murphy find oil west of Brae Field.

text.p: Marathon Oil said it and Murphy Oil Corp found oil on Block 16/6b of the U. K. North Sea, 150 miles northeast of Aberdeen, Scotland.

The company said the 16/6b-6 well was drilled to a depth of 7,150 feet and encountered 107 feet of net oil pay in Tertiary sands. The well, drilled in 361 feet of water 12 miles west of the Brae "A" platform, was suspended without testing. Further appraisal drilling is planned.
Block 16/6b is owned 62.5 percent by the operator, Marathon, and 37.5 percent by Murphy.
Marathon Oil is part of the USX-Marathon Group, a unit of USX Corp. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212 859-1610))
